tools.name: ceneo_search
tools.description: Search Ceneo.pl (Poland's price-comparison engine) by phrase. Returns each product's lowest price and how many shops offer it, plus its Ceneo product id (use it with ceneo_product_offers). Fetched live from Ceneo.pl (a few seconds via direct fetch; up to ~20s when routed through an unblocker backend

tools.name: ceneo_product_offers
tools.description: Given a Ceneo product id, return EVERY shop's offer (shop, price, link) sorted cheapest-first — the price comparison. Get the id from ceneo_search. Fetched live from Ceneo.pl (a few seconds via direct fetch; up to ~20s when routed through an unblocker backend).

tools.name: ceneo_product
tools.description: Product details from Ceneo: name, images, description, brand, price range, offer count and rating. Fetched live from Ceneo.pl (a few seconds via direct fetch; up to ~20s when routed through an unblocker backend).
